name: Deserving
overview: Scripture reveals that deserving is ultimately governed by God's just and sovereign will rather than human merit. While obedience to God's commandments brings blessings and exaltation (Deuteronomy 28:1), judgment and vengeance belong solely to the Lord (Romans 12:19), who requires accountability for life (Genesis 9:5). Jesus exemplifies this divine justice by doing nothing on His own but fulfilling the Father's will (John 5:30), praying specifically for those given to Him (John 17:9), and imparting God's love to them (John 17:26), underscoring that our standing before God is founded on His grace and purpose rather than our deserving.
